notes: Current USMLE reproductive/endocrine outline supports disorders of sex development and steroidogenic physiology.

GeneReviews and human genetics data support NR5A1/SF-1 as a nuclear receptor transcription factor controlling gonadal development and steroidogenic genes and causing 46,XY undervirilization often with normal adrenal function.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: 46,XY undervirilization with dysgenetic testes, normal cortisol/electrolytes and a heterozygous NR5A1 variant identifies SF-1 dysfunction; the protein transcriptionally regulates gonadal development and steroidogenesis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Androgen receptor, 5-alpha-reductase, SRY and AMHR2 perform distinct downstream or developmental functions and are not NR5A1/SF-1.
